about: Average hourly earnings in dollars, for the value of an hour in the cost of voting (model section 6). National default: CES0500000003, all employees, total private, seasonally adjusted. Values are read from FRED (second-hand; origin BLS) and checked month by month against the BLS API where BLS was read (check).

source.name: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis: BLS Current Employment Statistics and State and Metro Area series (fredgraph.csv per series)
source.licence: FRED prints that some series are copyrighted and refers to the series notes; the notes of these series name only the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics as source and print no other restriction [measured]; BLS data are a U.S. Government work
source.via: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

origin.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics (national) and State and Metro Area Employment, Hours, and Earnings (state)

source.note: Second-hand by the orchestrator's ruling of 2026-11-07 07:21: the BLS API's daily limit (25 requests per address) was reached; BLS's help pages and flat files answered Access Denied and were not tried another way.

check_against_bls.method: month-by-month comparison of every BLS API response held in the cache with FRED's value for the same series and month
check_against_bls.open: BLS API batches not yet read (daily limit reached on 2026-11-07); run `python3 pipeline/intake/bls_earnings.py --bls` after the limit resets to read the next batch, and again until all four are cached.
